text:
Maya: Uploaded a new 'checklist + right-rail' mock for first-run. Instead of a full-width quickstart, we show a concise task list + a collapsible sample projects rail. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/new-onboard (frame 'Checklist + Rail'). Quick feedback?

Ethan: Love the reduced clutter. Two quick concerns: will users notice the rail when collapsed? and how will this behave on narrow screens?

Jess: For discoverability we could try a subtle 3s pulse on the chevron the first time a user lands. Metric: sample_impression -> sample_start. Run for first-session only.

Priya: Accessibility: pulse animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion. Also contrast of the chevron label in the mock is 3.7:1. Need >=4.5:1 for AA. Focus outline is thin; recommend a 2px solid outline or a 4px focus ring shadow.

Sam: Dev constraints: dom order matters for assistive tech. Make the rail toggle the first interactive element in the checklist region so keyboard users hit it early. Also add data-qa attributes: data-qa="firstrun-samples-toggle" and data-qa="firstrun-sample-cta".

Jess: Microcopy: options for CTA on cards: "Try sample", "Start with sample", "Create sample project". Shortest for mobile is "Try sample". Consider org-level overrides for enterprise.

Maya: Good call on org override. We'll default samples ON for self-serve orgs, OFF for enterprise-managed orgs. Users can persist a personal preference as well.

Priya: Screen reader flow: when a sample is chosen and the checklist advances, use aria-live="polite" on the checklist region and move focus to the next task. Also ensure the toggle uses aria-expanded and has aria-controls pointing to the rail container.

Ethan: Animation suggestion: show one-time micro-animation arrow pointing to rail when checklist first appears. Keep subtle and accessible.

a11y-bot: Auto-scan note: collapse chevron missing aria-label in current Figma. Recommend aria-label="Expand sample projects" / "Collapse sample projects". Also flag: small text over sample images drops below 4.5:1.

Sam: CSS snippet to keep touch targets >=44px on mobile:
```
.firstrun-toggle { min-height:44px; padding: 10px 12px; }
.rail-cards { display:flex; gap:12px; overflow-x:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; }
```

Priya: Also ensure the tooltip/why-this modal is keyboard accessible and that its trigger has aria-describedby referencing the tooltip content.

Jess: I'll add analytics events: firstrun_sample_impression, firstrun_sample_expand, firstrun_sample_click, firstrun_sample_complete. Track activation method (keyboard vs pointer).

Maya: Plan: I'll update Figma today: 1) increase contrast, 2) add a11y notes (aria-labels, aria-live, focus move), 3) show pulse variant tied to prefers-reduced-motion, 4) include mobile copy variant. Will post updated frames and a 5-task usability script.

Ethan: :thumbsup: Let's run a short pilot with 1k users per arm before scaling.

Maya: Thanks all, will follow up once frames are updated and share the tiny PR suggestion for DOM ordering.
